items.guidance: The required variables GITHUB_REF_NAME and GITHUB_REPOSITORY suggest container/builder.dockerfile is a CI builder image, not the runtime image; check whether another Dockerfile in container/ builds the server. Use the production server command that the repository documents or its existing entrypoint script uses, listening on port 5000, and never a debug or development run mode.

Port 5000 is the detected application port; confirm the production server binds to 5000 in its settings file or start command before you add EXPOSE 5000. If the app reads its port from a settings file or another variable name instead of PORT, do not add ENV PORT; report the setting name.
